qualifier: monocyte and macrophage recruitment via CCR2/CX3CR1
name: Chemokine receptor-guided monocyte and macrophage recruitment
rationale: All members concern chemokine–receptor signalling and leukocyte chemotaxis, centred on monocyte/macrophage recruitment and CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, unlike confusables focused on lymphocyte homing, integrins or monocyte inflammatory activation.

name: IRF3-mediated antiviral type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover the cellular response to virus via IRF3-dependent type I IFN and IP-10 induction including cytosolic DNA sensing, whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/MDA5 RNA-helicase and dsRNA sensing.

qualifier: ryanodine-receptor ER release and calcium clearance
name: Ryanodine-receptor ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium lowering
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered ER/SR calcium (ryanodine channel, caffeine, skeletal muscle) and its reduction by Na/Ca exchange and ER reuptake, distinct from confusables on store-operated entry, calcium sensing and cardiac contraction.

name: Inhibition of long-chain fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: All three members restrain fatty acid import and beta-oxidation, unlike confusables on carnitine shuttle, lipid droplets, triglyceride catabolism or adiponectin/glucose uptake.

name: Gastrulation, germ layer specification and left-right patterning
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, mesendoderm/endoderm/lateral mesoderm formation, Nodal signalling and left-right asymmetry of gut and heart tube, distinct from confusables on later heart development and planar-cell-polarity convergent extension.

name: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members regulate postsynaptic actin, spine and dendrite morphogenesis together with LTP/LTD, reelin signalling and memory, unlike confusables on synapse assembly/adhesion or filopodial/BDNF signalling.

name: Platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation via collagen and ADP
rationale: All members concern platelet adhesion, activation, aggregation and degranulation, with collagen/GPVI and P2Y ADP signalling distinguishing it from confusables on VWF variants and thrombin/thromboxane/prostacyclin receptor signalling.

core: Innate receptor signalling to NF-kappaB and stress kinases
qualifier: TLR and NOD receptors via TAK1/IRAK
name: TLR and NOD signalling via TAK1 to NF-kappaB and JNK
rationale: Members describe TLR, NOD1/2 and related pattern-recognition signalling through TRAF6/IRAK/TAK1/IKK to NF-kappaB, JNK and p38, distinct from confusables on TNFR-family NF-kappaB, IKK deficiency diseases and negative MAPK regulation.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation and ossification from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members cover mesenchymal progenitor expansion, RUNX2/Wnt/BMP-driven osteoblast differentiation and direct/replacement ossification, distinct from confusables on mineralization, chondrocyte development and matrix secretion.

name: p16INK4A-CDK4/6-RB1 control of the G1/S transition
rationale: Members concern CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2 control of RB1/E2F at G1/S, including p16INK4A and RB1 defects and cyclin D/p27 degradation, unlike confusables on E2F target transcription, G2/M and p14ARF/TP53.

core: APC/C substrate degradation at mitotic exit
name: APC/C-Cdh1 switch and substrate degradation at mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C ubiquitin-ligase activity in late mitosis/early G1, including the Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch and Cdh1 autodegradation, distinct from confusables centred on APC/C:Cdc20 at metaphase-anaphase and Emi1/APC/C inhibition.

qualifier: Leloir pathway and its enzyme defects
name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members are the Leloir galactose pathway or its GALK1/GALT/GALE/GALM deficiencies, distinct from confusables on fructose, pentose and glucuronate metabolism.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling from receptor to TCF targets
rationale: Members span FZD/DVL activation, destruction-complex control of beta-catenin, TCF target regulation and oncogenic pathway mutants, distinct from confusables on Notch, Wnt secretion and non-canonical Wnt.

core: NMDA receptor signalling in LTP and memory
name: NMDA receptor calcium signalling to CREB in LTP and memory
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and Ca2+-driven CaMK/Ras/AMPK signalling to CREB and NPAS4 underlying LTP and memory, distinct from confusables on spine structural plasticity, cAMP modules and kainate/AMPA receptor trafficking.

core: Acid-sensing ion channels and epithelial fluid transport
name: Acid-sensing ion channels and CFTR-mediated epithelial fluid transport
rationale: Members combine pH-sensing channels (sour taste, TRP, TALK, acidic pH response) with CFTR-dependent anion and water transport and pancreatic secretion, distinct from confusables on SLC26/bicarbonate exchangers, apical protein sorting and saliva/itch.

core: Rab GTPase regulation and vesicle docking
name: Rab GTPase cycle, geranylgeranylation and SNARE-dependent vesicle docking
rationale: Members concern Rab GEF/GAP cycling, Rab prenylation, ARF signalling and SNARE-dependent vesicle docking, distinct from confusables on Golgi tethering/organization and general GTPase activity.

core: Axon guidance receptor signalling to RAC1
name: RAC1 activation by DCC and ephrin guidance receptors
rationale: The three members are DCC attraction, ephrin signalling and RAC1 activation in guidance, unlike confusables on netrin/EPH repulsion, ROBO-SLIT and DSCAM self-avoidance.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and motor coordination behaviour
rationale: Members link glycinergic transmission and its hyperekplexia defect with Purkinje layer formation, righting reflex and locomotion, distinct from confusables on GABA signalling, touch/proprioception and exploratory behaviours.

name: RNA polymerase III transcription from internal type 1/2 promoters
rationale: All members are steps of Pol III initiation, elongation and termination at type 1/2 (tRNA) promoters, distinct from confusables on type 3 snRNA promoters and Pol I rRNA transcription.

qualifier: synthesis from cholesterol, recycling and signalling
name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol, enterohepatic recycling and signalling
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis routes from cholesterol, CTX defect, LXR-regulated homeostasis, transport, recycling and signalling, distinct from confusables on ABC transporter defects, intestinal absorption and vitamin E/oxysterol disorders.

qualifier: aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
name: Vasopressin and aquaporin-mediated water, urea and glycerol transport
rationale: Members concern vasopressin signalling, renal water reabsorption and aquaporin/urea/glycerol channels, distinct from confusables on renin-angiotensin and sodium/osmotic regulation.

core: Histone methylation and chromatin remodelling complexes
name: Histone methyltransferase and CHD-NuRD chromatin remodelling complexes
rationale: Members are histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase complexes (KMT2D/MLL4, WDR5) and CHD/NuRD remodellers with transcription-factor cofactors, distinct from confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2 silencing and histone deacetylation/demethylation.

name: Glutathione gamma-glutamyl cycle and its inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, catabolism, transport and GCLC/GSS/GGT1/OPLAH deficiencies, distinct from confusables on general amino acid metabolism and transsulfuration.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in drug reward and reinforcement
rationale: Members link opioid/neuropeptide GPCR signalling, DARPP-32 and dense core vesicle release to responses to cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol and reward learning, distinct from confusables on dopamine receptor subtypes and innate social/sleep behaviours.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Glutamatergic and GABAergic synapse function and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members regulate excitatory and inhibitory transmission, spine/projection maintenance and postsynaptic organization with amyloid-beta response and sensorimotor gating, distinct from confusables on AMPA receptor clustering, reelin-driven plasticity and locomotor behaviour.
